# Configuration environment variables

Single registry: `lib/Config.php`. Inspect effective values with:

```bash
./phpc doctor --env
```

Image `ENV` pins in `Docker/dev/ubuntu-22.04/Dockerfile` shadow `script/ci-defaults.env`
defaults — `doctor --env` exits non-zero when they drift.
